narrative.overview:
ReviewIt reads as a well-run small law office's own intake system, not a consumer AI toy. A white paper ground, navy authority color, and warm off-white panels carry the whole system — the same restraint a real firm uses on its own letterhead. Nothing performs 'AI product': no dark terminal chrome, no neon accent, no chat-bubble Q&A. The system trusts plain hierarchy, generous whitespace, and one severity vocabulary (Blocker/Push/Note) to do the organizing work.

This replaced an earlier 'Gate Board' dark-terminal direction (near-black ground, cream ink, airport-departure-board metaphor), explicitly abandoned per CLAUDE.md's 'never revert to dark terminal theme' rule. The flag-row component itself is unchanged in behavior from that system — only its ground and neutral tones moved from dark to light.
keyCharacteristics: White page ground with off-white panel surfaces — never a dark ground anywhere in the product
Navy is the single authority color: buttons, logo, headings, final-CTA band — no competing blue accent
Two-voice type system: JetBrains Mono for data the signer scans, system sans for prose the signer reads
Flat by default — zero shadows; depth comes from one background-color step and 1px border dividers
Sharp 3px corners throughout; bordered rectangles instead of soft app chrome

rules.name: The One Color Per Severity Rule
rules.body: Each severity level (Blocker, Push, Note) owns exactly one label color, applied only to the severity label text — never blended into row backgrounds, borders, or icons at rest.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Mono is for data the signer scans (severity labels, clause names, panel micro-labels); sans is for prose the signer reads (why-text, quotes, answers, benefit copy). Never put a full sentence of prose in mono, and never label a data column in sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift with a shadow, at rest or on interaction. Depth is background-step + rule-divider only.

rules.name: The Bordered Rectangle Rule
rules.body: Interactive containers (buttons, form inputs) are bordered rectangles at 3px radius, not soft app chrome.

rules.name: The Authored-Mark Rule
rules.body: The logo mark and every landing-page illustration are hand-authored inline SVG in one consistent stroke weight, never an icon-font glyph, emoji, or CSS-gradient stand-in.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for severity labels, clause names, and panel micro-labels; system sans for everything the signer reads for meaning.
Do use the grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr technique for any new expand/collapse panel, not max-height.
Do author icons, the hero illustration, and the logo as inline SVG.
Do keep the flag-row component identical between the landing-page demo and the real result screen.
donts: Don't reintroduce the dark terminal ground, cream ink, or airport-board metaphor — that direction is retired.
Don't add a box-shadow anywhere in this system.
Don't use a pill-shaped button, a soft-shadow card, or a radius larger than 3px.
Don't use more than one severity color as a resting badge, border, or icon color.
Don't use a Unicode glyph, emoji, or CSS gradient as a stand-in icon.
Don't fall into the same-size icon+heading+text card grid for benefit sections — the trust section uses a flowing divided list, deliberately.
